verdict.rationale: Belvo documents retrieving account balances for connected users in Brazil (docs-1) and supports real-time POST data requests (docs-11). Its Smart Collections product watches a user's balance and notifies you when there are enough funds to collect via Pix (docs-4, docs-24), a first-party balance-before-payment flow close to an NSF check. However, the evidence never shows a dedicated, documented balance endpoint positioned for on-demand NSF or risk checks before initiating a payment. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented balance endpoint with real-time/freshness guarantees, documentation framing it for NSF and pre-payment risk checks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
